analysis.known_expected: -9 to -11 kcal/mol for allosteric TYK2 JH2 pocket (BMS 2019 J Med Chem)
analysis.root_cause: AutoDock Vina scoring is poorly calibrated for allosteric pseudokinase pockets. Protein prep used obabel -xr (no ADFRsuite, no Gasteiger charges, no protonation). Score underestimation is systematic for this pocket class.
analysis.positive_control_needed: Re-dock LAJ (co-crystal ligand) to verify pocket coordinates are correct
recommendation: 1. Use DiffDock (GPU-based, learned scoring) which handles allosteric pockets better
2. Or use ADFRsuite prepare_receptor4.py for proper protein prep before Vina
3. Or apply empirical correction: allosteric TYK2 JH2 pocket: add +4-6 kcal/mol to Vina score
4. Box center (1.3, 0.4, 33.4) is from LAJ centroid — verify against published structure
analysis.calibration_finding: Vina underestimates allosteric binding by ~4-6 kcal/mol vs orthosteric (protein prep + scoring function issue)
analysis.nda_confirmation: Despite docking underestimate, deucravacitinib NDA 214958 approved — genetic + ADMET evidence sufficient without accurate docking for this approved drug
